info.name: FaNG Thumbs
info.summary: Fast WebP previews for photos, camera RAW and video, from the FaNG Thumbs service
info.description:
Sends preview generation for images, camera RAW (including Apple ProRAW), video (including ProRes and HDR clips) and PDFs to a FaNG Thumbs container, which renders them in parallel as WebP. It replaces Imaginary. Nextcloud's own preview providers stay on as a fallback, so previews keep working when the service is down.
Configure it with occ:
occ config:app:set fangthumbs url --value=http://nextcloud-fang-thumbs:9000 occ config:app:set fangthumbs key --value=<the service's FANG_THUMBS_KEY> occ fangthumbs:test
Pre-generate previews for everything in parallel with `occ fangthumbs:generate`.
info.author: rlx
